messages:
maya: Quick thread — FinCo asked for explicit migration guardrails for models in our catalog. They want a non-breaking migration window + a clear rollback plan if quality regresses. Need product + eng alignment. :wave:

jorge: Which model are they talking about?

maya: Orca-lite-v3 (we onboarded it into catalog last week). They want a 90-day pin option and a 30-day migration credit if we require them to move earlier.

sam: For acceptance we should require a quantitative stability gate: run suite (~300 target prompts). Pass if per-class F1 drop < 2% AND embedding-similarity drop < 0.03. Also a perf SLO: p99 latency < 140ms for their tail.

liam: Operational plan: staged canary + automatic rollback triggers. Proposal: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Rollback if error-rate increases by >0.5 percentage points OR token-latency regresses >15%.

jorge: We can encode that as a rollout policy (cohort-canary) + metric hooks. Need a "pinned-exempt" flag so customers who used the 90-day pin keep traffic on the old model until they opt in or TTL expires.

ellsworth: From CS/commercial: legal needs an opt-in doc. If we give 90-day pin we must disclose that bug fixes/security patches may not be back-ported to pinned versions by default. Also need pricing impact for the migration credit.

maya: Product asks: define the exact "stability" gate artifact (bench spec + thresholds) and how we calculate "migration debt" cost. Also agree customer notification cadence: notify at 45d, 15d, and final 7d before forced cutover.

sam: I'll assemble the benchmark harness and canonical prompt set. Sample run I'll use for perf/regression checks:

```
bench-run --model orca-lite-v3 --suite finco-qe --target-p99=140 --sim-threshold=0.03 --save-report /tmp/orca-lite-v3-finco.json
```

jorge: Infra question: KV-cache/session compatibility and quantization mismatch. If their pinned model is int8 and new variant is bf16, we need to flag possible distributional changes in outputs. Add a compat test in onboarding checklist.

liam: Also require HotSwap fallback to preserve session KV where possible. If HotSwap can't preserve state, the rollout must drop to stateless endpoints or use session-migration shim. Ops-bot: see existing runbook.

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-migration-checklist — automated checks included: perf, regression thresholds, vuln-scan, and canary rollback triggers.

maya: Next steps: Sam -> bench results by Thu EOD; Jorge -> PR for rollout config and pinned-exempt flag; Product -> draft opt-in + notification text and legal template. I'll sync with FinCo about the 45-day notification plan.

ellsworth: I'll schedule the customer call and share migration-credit calc. :+1:
